# MultivariateTemporalEmbedding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method of encoding multiple time-varying input signals into a single quantum state via amplitude or angle encoding, preserving cross-channel correlations. Allows neuromorphic in-network nodes to process correlated sensor streams jointly, improving forecasting accuracy in distributed TCC/iNEST systems.
